# Coefficient

> Coefficient connects 100+ data sources directly to Google Sheets and Excel with AI-powered analysis and live data integration.

Coefficient is a no-code platform that enables business users to build live data connectors and AI dashboards without technical expertise. It supports integrations with databases, APIs, SaaS applications, and data warehouses for spreadsheet-based business intelligence and automation.

## Key Topics

- Data connectors
- AI dashboards
- Google Sheets
- Excel
- Spreadsheet automation
- No-code platform
- Data integration
- Business intelligence
- Live data sync
- API connectors
- Database integration
- Sales operations
- Financial forecasting
- Data apps
- No-code tools

## Getting Started

- [Coefficient Homepage](https://coefficient.io): Connect spreadsheets to 100+ data sources with AI
- [Product Overview](https://coefficient.io/product): Live data integration and AI analysis for spreadsheets

## Data Integrations

- [MySQL Integration](http://coefficient.io/integrations-google-sheets/mysql): MySQL data connector for Google Sheets and Excel integration
- [MySQL RDS Integration](http://coefficient.io/integrations-google-sheets/mysql-rds): MySQL RDS connector for spreadsheet data integration and automation
- [Amazon Redshift Integration](http://coefficient.io/integrations-google-sheets/amazon-redshift): Amazon Redshift integration for Google Sheets and Excel connectors
- [Google Search Console Integration](http://coefficient.io/integrations-google-sheets/google-search-console): Google Search Console integration guide for Sheets and Excel

## Financial & Business Applications

- [QuickBooks Integration](http://coefficient.io/integrations-google-sheets/quickbooks): QuickBooks integration for live financial data in spreadsheets
- [Sage Intacct Integration](http://coefficient.io/integrations-google-sheets/sage-intacct): Sage Intacct integration for accounting data in Sheets and Excel
